plan.title: Change the VSCode extensions icon to something more relevant
plan.overview: Replace the generic kanban board SVG icon with a Roman column/pillar design that represents Festina Lente's identity (Latin phrase from Caesar Augustus meaning "make haste slowly"). The new icon follows the same SVG conventions as the existing icon (24x24 viewBox, currentColor, stroke-width 1.5) and is referenced from package.json's activitybar configuration.

approach.rationale:
The existing kanban-icon.svg at apps/vscode/resources/kanban-icon.svg:1 establishes the SVG convention: 24x24 viewBox, fill="none", stroke="currentColor", stroke-width="1.5". The new icon follows this exact pattern to maintain theme compatibility (light/dark).
The Roman column design was chosen during scoping as the best representation of Festina Lente's identity — connecting to Roman origins while symbolizing structured, enduring foundations.
The icon path is referenced in a single location: apps/vscode/package.json:45 in the viewsContainers.activitybar[0].icon field. This is the only change needed to wire the new icon.

task.name: Create Roman column/pillar SVG icon
task.action:
- Create apps/vscode/resources/festinalente-icon.svg - Use 24x24 viewBox with fill="none" and xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" - Design a Roman column/pillar silhouette with these elements: - Capital (top): wider horizontal section with slight overhang - Shaft (middle): slightly narrower vertical body - Base (bottom): wider horizontal section for stability - Optional: 1-2 subtle vertical fluting lines on the shaft for detail - All stroke and fill values MUST use "currentColor" (no hex colors) - Use stroke-width="1.5" for primary outlines (matching existing convention) - Keep design simple enough to be recognizable at 16x16 rendering - Avoid fine details that would blur at small sizes
Reference — existing icon format (apps/vscode/resources/kanban-icon.svg): ```xml <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <!-- Elements use stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" --> </svg> ```
Target — approximate Roman column design: ```xml <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <!-- Capital (top wider section) --> <path d="M6 3h12v1H6z" ... /> <!-- Abacus/echinus transition --> <path d="M7 4h10v2H7z" ... /> <!-- Shaft --> <rect x="8" y="6" width="8" height="12" ... /> <!-- Base --> <path d="M7 18h10v2H7z" ... /> <path d="M6 20h12v1H6z" ... /> </svg> ``` Note: The exact coordinates should be refined for visual balance and clarity. The key constraint is: simple, recognizable at 16x16, currentColor only.
task.done: New SVG file exists at apps/vscode/resources/festinalente-icon.svg with a Roman column design using only currentColor
